```{r setup, echo = TRUE, include=TRUE, results = "markup", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}


library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)
library(class)

######################
# Prepare Data
######################
# Number of observations and variables
dim(penguins)
# Summary statistics
summary(penguins)

#Show number of NA
colSums(is.na(penguins))

#Creating new data set of only needed columns and drop rows where used columns are NA
penguins_clean <- penguins %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm) %>%
  drop_na()
#Show number of NA in clean data set
colSums(is.na(penguins_clean))

#######################
# Data Exploration
#######################

# Number of observations and variables
dim(penguins_clean)

# Variable types
str(penguins_clean)

# Summary statistics
summary(penguins_clean)

# Summary table
species_summary <- penguins_clean %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Bill = round(mean(bill_length_mm),1),
    SD_Bill = round(sd(bill_length_mm),1),
    Mean_Flipper = round(mean(flipper_length_mm),1),
    SD_Flipper = round(sd(flipper_length_mm),1),
    n = n()
  )

species_summary

# Unknown specimen
unknown <- data.frame(
  bill_length_mm = 45,
  flipper_length_mm = 220
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

##########################
# Visualization
##########################

p <- ggplot(penguins_clean,
       aes(x = bill_length_mm,
           y = flipper_length_mm,
           color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = unknown,
             aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                 y = flipper_length_mm),
             color = "black",
             shape = 8,
             size = 6,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Measurements by Species",
    subtitle = "Unknown specimen shown as black star",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
p

###################################
# KNN Classification
###################################

#creating new df with only predictor variables 
x_train <- penguins_clean %>%
  select(bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm)

#creates dependent variable
species <- penguins_clean$species

# Standardize measurements to make bill and flipper link are weighted the same in the model
x_all <- rbind(x_train, unknown)

x_scaled <- scale(x_all)

#separating the data back out, so train is the original penguins and the unknown pengion is seperate
train_scaled <- x_scaled[1:nrow(x_train), ]
test_scaled <- x_scaled[nrow(x_scaled), , drop = FALSE]

# KNN classification
k <- 15

prediction <- knn(
  train = train_scaled,
  test = test_scaled,
  cl = species,
  k = k,
  prob = TRUE
)
#gives predicition on which penguin the specimen belongs to
prediction

# Confidence estimate
confidence <- attr(prediction, "prob")
#returns that 15 of the 15 nearest neighbors were gentoo
confidence

cat("Predicted Species:", as.character(prediction), "\n")
cat("Classification Confidence:", round(confidence * 100, 1), "%\n")


```
